lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: We have a problem.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I need you to retrieve Volt Jr.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Before we proceed with the next study, I have to submit the performance report

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: along with the findings from the previous study.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Therefore, I need access to Volt Jr.
Volt Jr. was destroyed by a Rapture.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I know that.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: But to be perfectly honest, I'm not convinced that's true.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Volt Jr. is a major investment.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Unless I can provide proof that it was in fact destroyed, I could be suspected of embezzling funds.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: You won't have to bring in the actual carcass.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Photographic evidence of its destruction would suffice.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Since, as you say,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: you personally witnessed Volt Jr.'s demise,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: you should be able to send a photo as proof.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Is there a problem?
No. I'll get you your photo.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I'll be waiting.
